## Meaning

This monitor fired because the signal deviated from its own learned baseline by more than the configured number of deviations. It did NOT cross a fixed number, so 'the value looks normal to me' is not a reason to close this.

Query:

```
avg(last_15m):anomalies(sum:trace.http.client.request.errors{__SCOPE__} by {service,peer.service}.as_rate(), 'agile', 3) >= 1
```

## Impact

The service still functions but measurably worse; a subset of traffic or users is failing.

Error budget: this condition is associated with `slo-app-availability`. If the alert is sustained, expect burn-rate alerts on that objective to follow.

## Automation

Workflow `diag-dependency` (diagnostic only) runs automatically on every alert.

Actions: `fetch_monitor`, `peer_service_health`, `circuit_breaker_state`, `vendor_status_page`.

Attached to the alert automatically: peer service SLO state, breaker state, vendor status page result.

## Escalation

1. Owning team: `sre` (see `platform/policy/teams.yaml` for the channel and ServiceNow assignment group).
2. Escalates to: `platform-leadership`.
3. Priority contract: P2, P3 — ack within 10 minutes, escalate at 20.
